scripts.typecheck: for project in packages/core packages/providers packages/testing packages/widget packages/sdk packages/farm packages/assistant-ui packages/cli apps/gateway apps/control-plane apps/demo apps/site; do bunx tsc --noEmit -p $project || exit 1; done
scripts.check:packages: for package in packages/core packages/providers packages/widget packages/sdk packages/farm packages/assistant-ui; do publint $package --strict && attw --pack $package --profile esm-only || exit 1; done && publint packages/cli --strict
